source: The message of the hard string, as stored in the source locale: the original text, with the arguments of a template string as placeholders. Use it for a default value, as in {0}.
text: 硬编码字符串的消息，与源语言中存储的一致：即原始文本，其中模板字符串的参数作为占位符。可用于默认值，如 {0}。
